wnba.Headline: Scuffling Liberty call for more 'heart' after latest loss
wnba.Description: The Liberty are searching for answers after their fourth loss in five games, with star forward Breanna Stewart challenging her team to play with more heart.

wnba.Headline: Charles ties season high with 13 points as Valkyries down Liberty 76-67
wnba.Description: — Kaila Charles tied a season high with 13 points off the bench and the Golden State Valkyries held the New York Liberty to their lowest-scoring first half of the season en route to a 76-67 victory on Sunday night.

wnba.Headline: A'ja Wilson, Las Vegas Aces top Kamilla Cardoso, Chicago Sky
wnba.Description: Four-time MVP A'ja Wilson finished with 30 points and 15 rebounds Sunday as the Aces posted a 107-99 victory over Kamilla Cardoso and the Chicago Sky at United Center, Las Vegas' 14th win of the season and second in a row.

wnba.Headline: Mystics win marathon matchup, beat Fire in record-tying 4 OTs
wnba.Description: Sonia Citron scored a career-high 32 points, including the basket that put her team ahead to stay with 21.4 seconds left, and the Washington Mystics held off the Portland Fire 124-123 on Sunday in four overtimes -- tying the longest game in WNBA history.

wnba.Description: — Sonia Citron scored 32 points, including the basket that put her team ahead to stay with 21.4 seconds left, and the Washington Mystics held off the Portland Fire 124-123 on Sunday in four overtimes — tying the longest game in WNBA history.

wnba.Headline: A’ja Wilson has a WNBA first with 30 points, 15 rebounds, 4 steals, 3 blocks in Aces' win over Sky
wnba.Description: — A’ja Wilson had 30 points, 15 rebounds, four steals and three blocks to become the first player in WNBA history to reach those marks in a game as the Las Vegas Aces beat the Chicago Sky 107-99 on Sunday.

wnba.Headline: Lynx coach Cheryl Reeve ties WNBA regular-season wins record
wnba.Description: Cheryl Reeve tied Mike Thibault's WNBA record for career coaching wins at 379 as the Minnesota Lynx beat the Dallas Wings 85-77 on Sunday.

wnba.Headline: Howard and Miles score 21, Reeve ties WNBA coaching wins record as Lynx beat Wings 85-77
wnba.Description: — Natasha Howard had 21 points and 14 rebounds, Olivia Miles added 21 points and eight assists and Cheryl Reeve tied the WNBA record for career coaching wins as the Minnesota Lynx beat the Dallas Wings 85-77 on Sunday.

wnba.Headline: Rookies Flau'jae Johnson and Awa Fam lead the Storm to a 105-90 victory over the Dream
wnba.Description: — Flau'jae Johnson had 24 points and 11 rebounds, fellow rookie Awa Fam scored 21 points and the Seattle Storm never trailed in a 105-90 victory over the Atlanta Dream on Saturday night.

wnba.Headline: Parker, Delle Donne, Reeve enter Women's Basketball Hall of Fame
wnba.Description: Candace Parker and Elena Delle Donne, former rivals who each won two WNBA MVP awards, and Cheryl Reeve, who has won four titles as head coach, have been enshrined in the Women's Basketball Hall of Fame.
